course_name_original: Segurança Informática em Redes e Sistemas
course_name_en: Computer Security in Networks and Systems
syllabus_topics: Programming vulnerabilities and secure code development basics
Symmetric key management and distribution protocols
Digital certificates and public key infrastructure
Secure channels and virtual private networks (VPN)

assessment_methods.method: Exam (for students not approved in the project)
Project (for students not approved in the project)

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 8.0 is required on each exam. A minimum grade of 9.5 is required on the project. The final grade in the "normal period" is the best of: 45% exam + 40% project + 15% quizzes, or 60% exam + 40% project. For working students, the final grade is 60% exam + 40% project. For the special period, if the student is approved in the project, the grade is 60% exam + 40% project; if not approved, it's 60% exam + 40% exam on the practical part.
bibliography: André Zúquete, Segurança em redes informáticas 5ª edição, FCA. ISBN: 9789727228577, 2018
William Stallings, Network Security Essentials: Applications and Standards, 6th Edition, Pearson. ISBN: 978-0134527338, 2017
Ross Anderson, Security Engineering: A Guide to Building Dependable Distributed Systems, 3rd Edition, ISBN: 978-1-119-64281-7, 2020
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
